name: single leg sit (wall)
description: A one-legged wall sit that doubles the load on each leg and challenges balance and quad endurance.
instructions: Lean your back against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg and extend it in front of you.
Hold for 10-30 seconds while keeping your back flat on the wall.
Lower the leg and rest, then switch sides.
Keep your standing knee over your ankle.
